Кристальный титан — Сердце глубин: The Crystal Titan — Heart of the Deep
A bloody lunge into the enemy's blind spot.
A sweeping blow at everyone around.
Кто ест их каждый день, начинает видеть: Those who eat them every day begin to dream of a black sun. It doesn't shine — it watches. Today my apprentice didn't wake up. Under his skin glowed the same blue veins as in the caps. I burned the stores. The town cursed me.
A fist in these is already a weapon.
A dome of pure mana absorbs damage.
Кусок, который рудокопы отбили от сердца: A piece the miners chipped off the Stone One's heart. It still beats — and heals the hand that holds it.
An ice storm freezes everyone around.
The blade seems to swallow the light.
Лечит самого раненого союзника рядом. Уб: Heals the most wounded ally nearby. Kill it first.
An extra health potion at the start.
Nimble and perceptive children of the twilight.
A light step and quick feet.
A light wand for your first spells.

Мгновенно переносит к двери на следующий: Instantly carries you to the door to the next floor.
Медленная сфера взрывается чистой магией: A slow sphere bursts with pure magic.

A dwarven mechanism: bolt after bolt.
